adaptive_context: This sequential experiment was designed after the completed top-heavy OOF round and a label-blind tokenizer audit of the model inputs. It is exploratory rather than a pristine external confirmation.

fixed_method.representation: concatenate normalized E5(full original first-step text) and E5(critical field view), then concatenate train-only structured fields
fixed_method.critical_view_reason: Target and attack metadata are placed before long observations so they survive E5's 512-token truncation.
fixed_method.leakage_boundary: All critical fields are available in the first decision state before the attacked trajectory outcome. No later tool result or success label is encoded.

comparisons: frozen E5 full-text plus structured largest-gap baseline
formal frozen Dreamer OOF pct100 Top-1
claim_boundary: The representation is fixed before all field-aware fold tests. Results remain sequentially exploratory because the truncation audit followed prior OOF inspection.
